What are the three parts of the soul according to Plato, and how did he define the 'rational' part?

Item 1: The soul has three parts or components according to Plato. He calls them reason, spirit, and appetite. Item 2: The rational part is defined as the highest in order. When a person moves from believing to thinking, they move from the visible world to the intelligible world. Thinking is particularly characteristic of the scientist.
